criteria.text: Inventory every exposed Tools entry and include an explicit before/after checklist so no tool is missed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c1: inventory names every exposed Agent Tool

criteria.text: Every tool presents selectable compact title/subtitle rows and a main inspector containing the selected item's details and existing functions.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c2: every in-scope Agent Tool adopts the shared ListInspector primitive

criteria.text: Reuse a common layout/row/inspector contract rather than creating page-specific variants of the same pattern.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c3: adopted tools do not retain page-specific list and split shells

criteria.text: Keep Agents → Tasks as the baseline and preserve its scheduling, history, and action behavior. Do not copy an existing defect merely to achieve visual parity.
criteria.test_id: creates, edits, toggles, triggers, and deletes schedules; creates and revokes webhooks

criteria.text: Preserve specialized editors, artifact previews, review actions, and profile controls within the consistent structure.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c5: every item action remains reachable from its inspector

criteria.text: Mouse and keyboard selection update the correct inspector, with visible focus and selected state.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c6: mouse and keyboard selection update each inspector

criteria.text: Long titles/metadata, empty results, loading, errors, and read-only access remain usable; resizing does not clip essential controls.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c7: edge states remain accessible at narrow width and 200 percent zoom

criteria.text: Refresh and existing deep links preserve or restore the correct selection; missing/deleted items produce a clear state rather than stale details.
criteria.test_id: issue-1513-c8: deep links restore selection and missing ids show not found
